sun._help: Average sunrise / sunset for Des Moines around the 15th of each month (local clock time, DST included). The Home landscape blends between months so the sky shifts a little every day.

sync._help: JSONBin setup is per device (Admin → Sync), never in this public file. pollSeconds = how often a visible screen checks for other devices' changes.

_birthdays_help: Birthdays with a kid id (the girls) are always pinned to the Countdowns card. Everyone else competes with major holidays for the other 4 of 6 countdown slots. Birthdays also show on the calendar.
_kids_help: color = the girl's own color everywhere (Evelynn orange, Avery yellow); green is the whole family. art = an image used in her hexagon avatar instead of the emoji (Evelynn's orange butterfly).
